section.title: org.osgi.service.servlet.runtime.dto
section.para: Http Runtime DTO Package Version 2.0.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.
Example import for consumers using the API in this package:
Example import for providers implementing the API in this package:

listitem.para: BaseServletDTO - Represents common information about a jakarta.servlet.Servlet service.
DTOConstants - Defines standard constants for the DTOs.
ErrorPageDTO - Represents a jakarta.servlet.Servlet for handling errors and currently being used by a servlet context.
FailedErrorPageDTO - Represents a jakarta.servlet.Servlet service registered as an error page but currently not being used by a servlet context due to a problem.
FailedFilterDTO - Represents a servlet Filter service which is currently not being used by a servlet context due to a problem.
FailedListenerDTO - Represents a listener service which is currently not being used by a servlet context due to a problem.
FailedPreprocessorDTO - Represents a preprocessor service which is currently not being used due to a problem.
FailedResourceDTO - Represents a resource definition which is currently not being used by a servlet context due to a problem.
FailedServletContextDTO - Represents a servlet context that is currently not used due to some problem.
FailedServletDTO - Represents a jakarta.servlet.Servlet service which is currently not being used by a servlet context due to a problem.
FilterDTO - Represents a servlet jakarta.servlet.Filter service currently being used for by a servlet context.
ListenerDTO - Represents a listener currently being used by a servlet context.
PreprocessorDTO - Represents a preprocessor org.osgi.service.servlet.whiteboard.Preprocessor service currently being used during request processing.
RequestInfoDTO - Represents the services used to process a specific request.
ResourceDTO - Represents a resource definition currently being used by a servlet context.
RuntimeDTO - Represents the state of a Http Service Runtime.
ServletContextDTO - Represents a jakarta.servlet.ServletContext created for servlets, resources, servlet Filters, and listeners associated with that servlet context.
ServletDTO - Represents a jakarta.servlet.Servlet currently being used by a servlet context.

section.title: public abstract class BaseServletDTO extends DTO
section.para: Represents common information about a jakarta.servlet.Servlet service.

section.title: public boolean asyncSupported
section.para: Specifies whether the servlet supports asynchronous processing.

section.title: public Map<String, String> initParams
section.para: The servlet initialization parameters as provided during registration of the servlet. Additional parameters like the Http Service Runtime attributes are not included. If the service has no initialization parameters, the map is empty.

section.title: public String name
section.para: The name of the servlet. This value is never null, unless this object represents a FailedServletDTO or a FailedErrorPageDTO where the value might be null.

section.title: public long serviceId
section.para: Service property identifying the servlet. In the case of a servlet registered in the service registry and picked up by a Servlet Whiteboard Implementation, this value is not negative and corresponds to the service id in the registry. If the servlet has not been registered in the service registry, the value is negative and a unique negative value is generated by the Http Service Runtime in this case.

section.title: public long servletContextId
section.para: The service id of the servlet context for the servlet represented by this DTO.

section.title: public String servletInfo
section.para: The information string from the servlet.
This is the value returned by the Servlet.getServletInfo() method. For a FailedServletDTO or a FailedErrorPageDTO this is always null.

section.title: public final class DTOConstants
section.para: Defines standard constants for the DTOs.

section.title: public static final int FAILURE_REASON_EXCEPTION_ON_INIT = 4
section.para: An exception occurred during initializing of the service.
This reason can only happen for servlets and servlet filters.

section.title: public static final int FAILURE_REASON_NO_SERVLET_CONTEXT_MATCHING = 1
section.para: No matching org.osgi.service.servlet.context.ServletContextHelper.

section.title: public static final int FAILURE_REASON_SERVICE_IN_USE = 7
section.para: The service is not registered as a prototype scoped service and is already in use with a servlet context and therefore can't be used with another servlet context.

section.title: public static final int FAILURE_REASON_SERVICE_NOT_GETTABLE = 5
section.para: The service is registered in the service registry but getting the service fails as it returns null.

section.title: public static final int FAILURE_REASON_SERVLET_CONTEXT_FAILURE = 2
section.para: Matching org.osgi.service.servlet.context.ServletContextHelper, but the context is not used due to a problem with the context.

section.title: public static final int FAILURE_REASON_SERVLET_READ_FROM_DEFAULT_DENIED = 10
section.para: The servlet is not registered as it is configured to have multipart enabled, but the bundle containing the servlet has no read permission to the default location for the uploaded files.

section.title: public static final int FAILURE_REASON_SERVLET_WRITE_TO_LOCATION_DENIED = 8
section.para: The servlet is not registered as it is configured to have multipart enabled, but the bundle containing the servlet has no write permission to the provided location for the uploaded files.

section.title: public static final int FAILURE_REASON_SHADOWED_BY_OTHER_SERVICE = 3
section.para: Service is shadowed by another service.
For example, another service with the same service properties but having a higher service ranking. See org.osgi.framework.ServiceReference.compareTo(Object).

section.title: public static final int FAILURE_REASON_UNKNOWN = 0
section.para: Failure reason is unknown.

section.title: public static final int FAILURE_REASON_VALIDATION_FAILED = 6
section.para: The service is registered in the service registry but the service properties are invalid.

section.title: public static final int FAILURE_REASON_WHITEBOARD_WRITE_TO_DEFAULT_DENIED = 9
section.para: The servlet is not registered as it is configured to have multipart enabled, but the whiteboard implementation has no write permission to the default location for the uploaded files.

section.title: public static final int FAILURE_REASON_WHITEBOARD_WRITE_TO_LOCATION_DENIED = 11
section.para: The servlet is not registered as it is configured to have multipart enabled, but the whiteboard implementation has no write permission to the provided location for the uploaded files.

section.title: public class ErrorPageDTO extends BaseServletDTO
section.para: Represents a jakarta.servlet.Servlet for handling errors and currently being used by a servlet context.

section.title: public long[] errorCodes
section.para: The error codes the error page is used for. This array might be empty.

section.title: public String[] exceptions
section.para: The exceptions the error page is used for. This array might be empty.

section.title: public class FailedErrorPageDTO extends ErrorPageDTO
section.para: Represents a jakarta.servlet.Servlet service registered as an error page but currently not being used by a servlet context due to a problem.

As the servlet represented by this DTO is not used due to a failure, the field FailedErrorPageDTO.servletContextId always returns 0 and does not point to an existing org.osgi.service.servlet.context.ServletContextHelper.

section.title: public int failureReason
section.para: The reason why the servlet represented by this DTO is not used.

section.title: public class FailedFilterDTO extends FilterDTO
section.para: Represents a servlet Filter service which is currently not being used by a servlet context due to a problem.
As the service represented by this DTO is not used due to a failure, the field FailedFilterDTO.servletContextId always returns 0 and does not point to an existing servlet context.

section.title: public int failureReason
section.para: The reason why the servlet filter represented by this DTO is not used.

section.title: public class FailedListenerDTO extends ListenerDTO
section.para: Represents a listener service which is currently not being used by a servlet context due to a problem.
As the listener represented by this DTO is not used due to a failure, the field FailedErrorPageDTO.servletContextId always returns 0 and does not point to an existing servlet context.

section.title: public int failureReason
section.para: The reason why the listener represented by this DTO is not used.

section.title: public class FailedPreprocessorDTO extends PreprocessorDTO
section.para: Represents a preprocessor service which is currently not being used due to a problem.

section.title: public int failureReason
section.para: The reason why the preprocessor represented by this DTO is not used.

section.title: public class FailedResourceDTO extends ResourceDTO
section.para: Represents a resource definition which is currently not being used by a servlet context due to a problem.
As the resource represented by this DTO is not used due to a failure, the field FailedResourceDTO.servletContextId always returns 0 and does not point to an existing servlet context.

section.title: public int failureReason
section.para: The reason why the resource represented by this DTO is not used.

section.title: public class FailedServletContextDTO extends ServletContextDTO
section.para:
Represents a servlet context that is currently not used due to some problem.
The following fields return an empty array for a FailedServletContextDTO:
The method ServletContextDTO.attributes returns an empty map for a FailedServletContextDTO.

section.title: public int failureReason
section.para: The reason why the servlet context represented by this DTO is not used.

section.title: public class FailedServletDTO extends ServletDTO
section.para: Represents a jakarta.servlet.Servlet service which is currently not being used by a servlet context due to a problem.
As the servlet represented by this DTO is not used due to a failure, the field FailedServletDTO.servletContextId always returns 0 and does not point to an existing servlet context.

section.title: public int failureReason
section.para: The reason why the servlet represented by this DTO is not used.

section.title: public class FilterDTO extends DTO
section.para: Represents a servlet jakarta.servlet.Filter service currently being used for by a servlet context.

section.title: public boolean asyncSupported
section.para: Specifies whether the servlet filter supports asynchronous processing.

section.title: public String[] dispatcher
section.para: The dispatcher associations for the servlet filter.
The specified names are used to determine in what occasions the servlet filter is called. This array is never null.

section.title: public Map<String, String> initParams
section.para: The servlet filter initialization parameters as provided during registration of the servlet filter. Additional parameters like the Http Service Runtime attributes are not included. If the servlet filter has not initialization parameters, this map is empty.

section.title: public String name
section.para: The name of the servlet filter. This field is never null.

section.title: public String[] patterns
section.para: The request mappings for the servlet filter.
The specified patterns are used to determine whether a request is mapped to the servlet filter. This array might be empty.

section.title: public String[] regexs
section.para: The request mappings for the servlet filter.
The specified regular expressions are used to determine whether a request is mapped to the servlet filter. This array might be empty.

section.title: public long serviceId
section.para: Service property identifying the servlet filter. In the case of a servlet filter registered in the service registry and picked up by a Servlet Whiteboard Implementation, this value is not negative and corresponds to the service id in the registry. If the servlet filter has not been registered in the service registry, the value is negative and a unique negative value is generated by the Http Service Runtime in this case.

section.title: public long servletContextId
section.para: The service id of the servlet context for the servlet filter represented by this DTO.

section.title: public String[] servletNames
section.para: The servlet names for the servlet filter.
The specified names are used to determine the servlets whose requests are mapped to the servlet filter. This array might be empty.

section.title: public class ListenerDTO extends DTO
section.para: Represents a listener currently being used by a servlet context.

section.title: public long serviceId
section.para: Service property identifying the listener. In the case of a Listener registered in the service registry and picked up by a Servlet Whiteboard Implementation, this value is not negative and corresponds to the service id in the registry. If the listener has not been registered in the service registry, the value is negative and a unique negative value is generated by the Http Service Runtime in this case.

section.title: public long servletContextId
section.para: The service id of the servlet context for the listener represented by this DTO.

section.title: public String[] types
section.para: The fully qualified type names the listener. This array is never empty.

section.title: public class PreprocessorDTO extends DTO
section.para: Represents a preprocessor org.osgi.service.servlet.whiteboard.Preprocessor service currently being used during request processing.

section.title: public Map<String, String> initParams
section.para: The preprocessor initialization parameters as provided during registration of the preprocessor. Additional parameters like the Http Service Runtime attributes are not included. If the preprocessor has not initialization parameters, this map is empty.

section.title: public long serviceId
section.para: Service property identifying the preprocessor. In the case of a preprocessor registered in the service registry and picked up by a Servlet Whiteboard Implementation, this value is not negative and corresponds to the service id in the registry. If the preprocessor has not been registered in the service registry, the value is negative and a unique negative value is generated by the Http Service Runtime in this case.

section.title: public class RequestInfoDTO extends DTO
section.para: Represents the services used to process a specific request.

section.title: public FilterDTO[] filterDTOs
section.para: The servlet filters processing this request. If no servlet filters are called for processing this request, an empty array is returned.

section.title: public String path
section.para: The path of the request relative to the root.

section.title: public ResourceDTO resourceDTO
section.para: The resource processing this request. If the request is processed by a resource, this field points to the DTO of the resource. If the request is processed by another type of component like a servlet, this field is null.

section.title: public long servletContextId
section.para: The service id of the servlet context processing the request represented by this DTO.

section.title: public ServletDTO servletDTO
section.para: The servlet processing this request. If the request is processed by a servlet, this field points to the DTO of the servlet. If the request is processed by another type of component like a resource, this field is null.

section.title: public class ResourceDTO extends DTO
section.para: Represents a resource definition currently being used by a servlet context.

section.title: public String[] patterns
section.para: The request mappings for the resource.
The specified patterns are used to determine whether a request is mapped to the resource. This value is never null.

section.title: public String prefix
section.para: The prefix of the resource.

section.title: public long serviceId
section.para: Service property identifying the resource. In the case of a resource registered in the service registry and picked up by a Servlet Whiteboard Implementation, this value is not negative and corresponds to the service id in the registry. If the resource has not been registered in the service registry, the value is negative and a unique negative value is generated by the Http Service Runtime in this case.

section.title: public long servletContextId
section.para: The service id of the servlet context for the resource represented by this DTO.

section.title: public class RuntimeDTO extends DTO
section.para: Represents the state of a Http Service Runtime.

section.title: public FailedErrorPageDTO[] failedErrorPageDTOs
section.para: Returns the representations of the error page jakarta.servlet.Servlet services associated with this runtime but currently not used due to some problem. The returned array may be empty.

section.title: public FailedFilterDTO[] failedFilterDTOs
section.para: Returns the representations of the jakarta.servlet.Filter services associated with this runtime but currently not used due to some problem. The returned array may be empty.

section.title: public FailedListenerDTO[] failedListenerDTOs
section.para: Returns the representations of the listeners associated with this runtime but currently not used due to some problem. The returned array may be empty.

section.title: public FailedPreprocessorDTO[] failedPreprocessorDTOs
section.para: Returns the representations of the servlet org.osgi.service.servlet.whiteboard.Preprocessor services associated with this runtime but currently not used due to some problem. The returned array may be empty.

section.title: public FailedResourceDTO[] failedResourceDTOs
section.para: Returns the representations of the resources associated with this runtime but currently not used due to some problem. The returned array may be empty.

section.title: public FailedServletContextDTO[] failedServletContextDTOs
section.para: Returns the representations of the jakarta.servlet.ServletContext objects currently not used by the Http service runtime due to some problem. The returned array may be empty.

section.title: public FailedServletDTO[] failedServletDTOs
section.para: Returns the representations of the jakarta.servlet.Servlet services associated with this runtime but currently not used due to some problem. The returned array may be empty.

section.title: public PreprocessorDTO[] preprocessorDTOs
section.para: Returns the representations of the org.osgi.service.servlet.whiteboard.Preprocessor objects used by the Http Service Runtime. The returned array may be empty if the Http Service Runtime is currently not using any org.osgi.service.servlet.whiteboard.Preprocessor objects.

section.title: public ServiceReferenceDTO serviceDTO
section.para: The DTO for the corresponding org.osgi.service.servlet.runtime.HttpServiceRuntime. This value is never null.

section.title: public ServletContextDTO[] servletContextDTOs
section.para: Returns the representations of the jakarta.servlet.ServletContext objects used by the Http Service Runtime. The returned array may be empty if the Http Service Runtime is currently not using any jakarta.servlet.ServletContext objects.

section.title: public class ServletContextDTO extends DTO
section.para: Represents a jakarta.servlet.ServletContext created for servlets, resources, servlet Filters, and listeners associated with that servlet context. The Servlet Context is usually backed by a ServletContextHelper service.

section.title: public Map<String, Object> attributes
section.para: The servlet context attributes.

The value type must be a numerical type, Boolean, String, DTO or an array of any of the former. Therefore this method will only return the attributes of the servlet context conforming to this constraint. Other attributes are omitted. If there are no attributes conforming to the constraint, an empty map is returned.

section.title: public String contextPath
section.para:
The servlet context path.
This is the value returned by the ServletContext.getContextPath() method.

section.title: public ErrorPageDTO[] errorPageDTOs
section.para:
Returns the representations of the error page Servlet services associated with this context.
The representations of the error page Servlet services associated with this context. The returned array may be empty if this context is currently not associated with any error pages.

section.title: public FilterDTO[] filterDTOs
section.para:
Returns the representations of the servlet Filter services associated with this context.
The representations of the servlet Filter services associated with this context. The returned array may be empty if this context is currently not associated with any servlet Filter services.

section.title: public Map<String, String> initParams
section.para: The servlet context initialization parameters. This is the set of parameters provided when registering this context. Additional parameters like the Http Service Runtime attributes are not included. If the context has no initialization parameters, this map is empty.

section.title: public ListenerDTO[] listenerDTOs
section.para:
Returns the representations of the listener services associated with this context.
The representations of the listener services associated with this context. The returned array may be empty if this context is currently not associated with any listener services.

section.title: public String name
section.para: The name of the servlet context. The name of the corresponding ServletContextHelper.
This is the value returned by the ServletContext.getServletContextName() method.

section.title: public ResourceDTO[] resourceDTOs
section.para:
Returns the representations of the resource services associated with this context.
The representations of the resource services associated with this context. The returned array may be empty if this context is currently not associated with any resource services.

section.title: public long serviceId
section.para: Service property identifying the servlet context. In the case of a servlet context backed by a org.osgi.service.servlet.context.ServletContextHelper registered in the service registry and picked up by a Servlet Whiteboard Implementation, this value is not negative and corresponds to the service id in the registry. If the servlet context is not backed by a service registered in the service registry, the value is negative and a unique negative value is generated by the Http Service Runtime in this case.

section.title: public ServletDTO[] servletDTOs
section.para:
Returns the representations of the Servlet services associated with this context.
The representations of the Servlet services associated with this context. The returned array may be empty if this context is currently not associated with any Servlet services.

section.title: public class ServletDTO extends BaseServletDTO
section.para: Represents a jakarta.servlet.Servlet currently being used by a servlet context.

section.title: public boolean multipartEnabled
section.para: Specifies whether multipart support is enabled.

section.title: public int multipartFileSizeThreshold
section.para: Specifies the size threshold after which the file will be written to disk. If multipart is not enabled for this servlet, 0 is returned.

section.title: public String multipartLocation
section.para: Specifies the location where the files can be stored on disk. If multipart is not enabled for this servlet, null is returned.

section.title: public long multipartMaxFileSize
section.para: Specifies the maximum size of a file being uploaded. If multipart is not enabled for this servlet, 0 is returned.

section.title: public long multipartMaxRequestSize
section.para: Specifies the maximum request size. If multipart is not enabled for this servlet, 0 is returned.

section.title: public String[] patterns
section.para: The request mappings for the servlet.
The specified patterns are used to determine whether a request is mapped to the servlet. This array is never null. It might be empty for named servlets.
